newsitem.title: UK: London has no comment on Entergy talks.
newsitem.headline: London has no comment on Entergy talks.

text.p: British regional electricity company London Electricity said it had no comment on a statement by U.S. group Entergy that talks between the two companies had ended.
A spokesman said the company was deciding whether to make any further statement.
Entergy said on Wednesday that exploratory discussions between the two firms had been discontinued.
The company was responding to newspaper reports that it was mulling a 1.2 billion stg bid for the Rec.
Entergy said it continued "to evaluate attractive markets and investment opportunities worldwide and consider the UK market to be in that category," however.
